slides.title: Why is Addis Ababa hosting a WHO emergency meeting?
A first for Africa
slides.body: Ethiopia hosts the 7th WHO Emergency Medical Teams Global Meeting, Prensa Latina reports.

slides.title: Who is organizing
slides.body: Ethiopia's Health Ministry, the Ethiopian Public Health Institute and WHO. It runs to Nov 5.

slides.title: What officials say
slides.body: An EPHI director says it is a chance to share lessons on responding to health emergencies.

slides.title: Protect health care and keep aid access open.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
